payload.title: CI in GitHub, deploy verified build to Amplify; reconcile develop
payload.description: develop kept the retired S3/CloudFront workflow while main moved to Amplify on Sept 18; the content repo still builds and syncs every content push to the retired S3 bucket; Amplify still runs the full Gatsby build on every main push. Goal: GitHub Actions builds and verifies on PRs and pushes; on main, only after a green build, upload the verified public/ to Amplify (manual-deploy app) so Amplify spends no build minutes. Also: merge main into develop (Git Flow), restore /posts/ excerpt headlines, restore content-repo redirect pages that 404 in production.
